Aubrey Modiba.note: Modiba has been part of South Africa's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Aubrey Modiba.noteZh: 他在South Africa体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Bradley Cross.summary: Bradley Cross is a South Africa left-back from Kaizer Chiefs who adds wide defending, left-footed balance, and recovery speed to the national team.
Bradley Cross.note: Cross is defensive cover for South Africa's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Bradley Cross.noteZh: 他是South Africa在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Evidence Makgopa.note: Makgopa gives South Africa a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Evidence Makgopa.noteZh: 他是South Africa在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Ime Okon.note: Okon has been part of South Africa's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Ime Okon.noteZh: 他在South Africa体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Iqraam Rayners.note: Rayners is an attacking change-up for South Africa. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Iqraam Rayners.noteZh: 他是South Africa的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Jayden Adams.note: Adams is midfield insurance for South Africa. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Jayden Adams.noteZh: 他给South Africa一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Kamogelo Sebelebele.note: Sebelebele is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For South Africa, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Kamogelo Sebelebele.noteZh: 他给South Africa提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Khuliso Mudau.note: Mudau has been part of South Africa's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Khuliso Mudau.noteZh: 他给South Africa后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Khulumani Ndamane.note: Ndamane is back-line insurance for South Africa. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Khulumani Ndamane.noteZh: 他给South Africa那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Lyle Foster.note: Foster is one of South Africa's named attacking routes in this tournament. His job is to make the first defender move so the finish or final pass can appear.
Lyle Foster.noteZh: 他给South Africa一种把控球变成压力的路线。他要让防守者必须做选择。

Mbekezeli Mbokazi.note: Mbokazi has been part of South Africa's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Mbekezeli Mbokazi.noteZh: 他给South Africa后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Nkosinathi Sibisi.note: Sibisi is defensive cover for South Africa's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Nkosinathi Sibisi.noteZh: 他是South Africa在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Olwethu Makhanya.note: Makhanya is the kind of defender South Africa can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Olwethu Makhanya.noteZh: 他是South Africa艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Oswin Appollis.note: Appollis has been one of South Africa's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Oswin Appollis.noteZh: 他是South Africa这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Relebohile Mofokeng.note: Mofokeng is the midfield player South Africa can use when possession needs a sharper touch near the box. He tries to make one small gap matter.
Relebohile Mofokeng.noteZh: 他给South Africa一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Ricardo Goss.note: Goss sits behind the starter for South Africa, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Ricardo Goss.noteZh: 他给South Africa保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Ronwen Williams.note: Williams has carried the keeper minutes for South Africa. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Ronwen Williams.noteZh: 他是South Africa防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Samukele Kabini.note: Kabini gives South Africa cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Samukele Kabini.noteZh: 他是South Africa后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Sipho Chaine.note: Chaine is South Africa's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Sipho Chaine.noteZh: 他是South Africa的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Sphephelo Sithole.note: Sithole has been one of South Africa's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Sphephelo Sithole.noteZh: 他是South Africa这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Teboho Mokoena.note: Mokoena's World Cup has already included a goal against Czechia. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Teboho Mokoena.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Thabang Matuludi.note: Matuludi is back-line insurance for South Africa. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Thabang Matuludi.noteZh: 他给South Africa那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Thalente Mbatha.note: Mbatha gives South Africa midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Thalente Mbatha.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对South Africa来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Thapelo Maseko.note: Maseko is on the scoresheet for South Africa, with his goal coming against South Korea. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Thapelo Maseko.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Themba Zwane.note: Zwane gives South Africa a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Themba Zwane.noteZh: 他是South Africa的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Tshepang Moremi.note: Moremi has one tournament assist in the bank for South Africa. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Tshepang Moremi.noteZh: 他已经帮South Africa制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。
